invitationOverlay.cardIntro: we warmly invite you to celebrate our wedding with us

story.paragraphOne: What began as a chance encounter became the most beautiful story of our lives. Merle and Lasse met when life had other plans – and yet everything seemed to be exactly as it was meant to be.
story.paragraphTwo: Together we have laughed, argued, travelled and dreamed. Every moment together is a gift. And now we are looking forward to celebrating the most beautiful day with all the people who mean the most to us.
story.quote: I choose you – today, tomorrow and every day after.

events.title: Arrival
events.description: We'll start relaxed with drinks, music and the first shared moments.

events.title: Polterabend & Buffet
events.description: Celebrating, raising a glass and enjoying the evening together.

events.title: Dinner & Program
events.description: A festive table, speeches and unforgettable moments.

events.title: First Dance & Party
events.description: Dancing until our shoes are on fire.

venue.name: Heimathaus Tornesch
venue.description: The ceremony will take place outdoors, and the celebration will be under a tent. Please plan your journey in good time.

stay.title: Accommodation Nearby
stay.description: We have collected a few nearby accommodation options. Please book early, as availability may be limited.

accommodations.name: Hotel Esinger Hof
accommodations.description: Cosy accommodation in the Tornesch area.

accommodations.name: Hotel Dias
accommodations.description: A central option in Pinneberg with good connections.

accommodations.name: Booking.com
accommodations.description: More hotels and holiday rentals in Tornesch, Pinneberg and the surrounding area.

info.parking: Free parking is available directly at or near the venue.
info.accessibility: The venue is generally easy to access. If you have any special requirements, please let us know in advance.

dressCode.title: Dresscode
dressCode.intro: We would love to see you in elegant festive attire. Here is our colour palette for inspiration.
dressCode.note: This is only meant as guidance, and we completely understand if you do not have these colours at home. Please avoid pure white, black or red – all other colours are warmly welcome.

rsvp.title: RSVP
rsvp.contactText: So we know who is coming and how we can reach you.
rsvp.attendanceText: We would be delighted to welcome you to our wedding.
rsvp.yesText: I’m looking forward to celebrating with you.
rsvp.noText: Sadly, I won’t be able to attend.
rsvp.detailsText: So we can prepare everything perfectly.
rsvp.polterabend: I will also join the Polterabend on Friday. 🎉
rsvp.successText: We have received your response and are so excited to celebrate with you.
rsvp.calendarDescription: We are getting married! Celebrate this special day with us.

message.paragraphOne: Every relationship is a journey, and we are incredibly grateful that you are part of our story.
message.paragraphTwo: From the first shared moments to this special day – you have accompanied us, supported us and laughed with us.
message.highlight: Thank you for celebrating with us. We are looking forward to unforgettable moments with all of you.

items.question: What should I wear?
items.answer: We would love elegant attire in colourful shades. Most importantly, we want you to feel comfortable.

items.question: Can I take photos?
items.answer: During the ceremony, we kindly ask you not to take photos. Afterwards, we would love to see your snapshots.

items.question: Can I bring children?
items.answer: We love children, but the celebration is planned as an adults-only event.

items.question: Will there be vegetarian or vegan options?
items.answer: Yes, of course. Please simply let us know your preferences and allergies in the RSVP.

items.question: Where can I stay overnight?
items.answer: In the location section, you will find some recommendations for accommodation nearby.

items.question: What would you like as a wedding gift?
items.answer: The most important thing for us is that you are there. If you would like to give us something, we would be happy about a contribution to our honeymoon.

contacts.bottomText: Whether it is about organisational questions, accommodation or simply a friendly chat – these wonderful people will be happy to help you.

items.name: Mie Maleen
items.funFact: Mie is Merle’s sister and always up for fun ☀️

items.name: Gitte & Marco
items.funFact: Gitte and Marco are the best hosts – they know the venue like the back of their hand.

items.name: Matti
items.funFact: Matti is Lasse’s brother and the perfect person to contact for any questions about the celebration.

items.name: Bobby
items.funFact: Bobby is our loyal dog and brings good vibes – he is looking forward to getting cuddles from you!

items.name: Leona
items.funFact: Merle’s bestie and soulmate – she knows all the secrets and is excited to celebrate with you!
